item.title: Knoxville man gets 1969 Mustang back from shop unfinished after 5-year wait
item.description: A Knoxville man, who paid thousands of dollars to have his vintage Mustang modified, had to go to court to get it back from a shop in Sevierville.

item.title: CVS Health spends more than $1M on TV ads to block pharmacy bill
item.description: According to federal records, CVS Health has spent around $1.3 million on television ads across Tennessee in an effort to block a bill they say would force more than 100 pharmacies to close.

item.title: Bill would establish cold case division at the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation
item.description: A recently-proposed bill would establish a cold case division at the TBI, expanding the agency's ability to solve sometimes decades-old cases.

item.title: Fentress County Commission appoints interim sheriff
item.description: The Fentress County Commission has voted to appoint an interim sheriff until the August 2026 elections.

item.title: Knoxville sports coach indicted on sexual battery charges
item.description: A Knoxville man who coached youth sports teams has been indicted on multiple charges including aggravated sexual battery, the Knoxville Police Department said Tuesday.
